assessment rubric

  • CURIE: gmeow:assessmentRubric
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/assessmentRubric
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/norms
  • Box roles: RBox role (What is this?)

The rubric under which this assessment was made — version-pinning context for the score. Functional. Plays the observationMethod role without the subproperty axiom (claimModality pattern).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:Assessment -> gmeow:Rubric; functional

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:assessmentRubric from gmeow:Assessment to gmeow:Rubric when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:Assessment, gmeow:Rubric

Usage Advice

Use when

  • Use on an Assessment to name the rubric under which it was made — version-pinning context for the score.

Avoid when

  • Avoid more than one rubric per assessment (it is functional) and avoid omitting both rubric and criterion (at least one is required — SHACL).

How to use

  • Assert gmeow:assessmentRubric once per assessment; it plays the observationMethod role without the subproperty axiom, pinning the rubric version the score belongs to.

Examples

  • ex:as1 gmeow:assessmentRubric ex:voiceRubric.
